description: Use this when authoring an Examples block in a public Python SDK docstring, reviewing a docstring that lacks runnable examples, wiring pytest to discover doctests, or fixing a doctest broken by a signature change. Covers Google-style Examples placement, # doctest: +SKIP for I/O-bound calls, ELLIPSIS and NORMALIZE_WHITESPACE flags, multi-line continuations and <BLANKLINE>, exception expected-output form, README doctests via --doctest-glob, and pyproject.toml addopts wiring for --doctest-modules. Triggers: doctest, Examples:, >>>, +SKIP, +ELLIPSIS, +NORMALIZE_WHITESPACE, --doctest-modules, --doctest-glob, BLANKLINE, IGNORE_EXCEPTION_DETAIL.
